$comment: Single source of truth for every booru/image origin the app talks to.
Read by: apps/desktop/src/services/booruSources.ts (renderer, via import),
apps/desktop/electron/booru-registry.cjs (Electron main, via readFileSync),
apps/desktop/vite.config.ts (dev proxy table + /px allowlist).
Adding a mirror = one row here. No runtime may hardcode a booru host.
kind: dapi | moebooru | realhtml | booruorg | redgifs | paheal | imhentai | babesource
category: hentai | real  (drives the player feed allow-list)
id: canonical short id (Electron main source id).
healthId: the key the renderer uses for mirror-health cooldowns.
devProxy: same-origin prefix the Vite dev server proxies to origin. null = no path proxy.
referer: Referer header these hosts require. Omit to send origin + slash.
imageHosts: extra hosts serving this source BYTES (yande 302s to files.yande.re,
booru.org serves from img. and thumbs.booru.org). Matched by devFetchable and /px.
devBytes: how a browser-dev fetch of this origin bytes is routed.
proxy = same-origin devProxy prefix (mirror sends ACAO, or we set Referer).
px    = /px?u= (bytes redirect, lack ACAO, or are hotlink-protected).
pxSubdomains: true = the origin uses its devProxy but its SUBDOMAINS go through
/px (xbooru serves JSON from xbooru.com, images from img.xbooru.com).
byteHosts below are non-booru CDN media (feed posts, avatars) that are always
fetched through /px because they send no ACAO.
enabled: false keeps the row documented but out of every runtime.
caps: what the ADAPTER PROVABLE can do, audited from the code that builds
its request. Every field is OPTIONAL and an absent field means UNKNOWN,
never a default — we do not infer an API guarantee from the fact that our
client-side filter happened to pass.
tags: 'and' | 'or' | 'single' | 'none' — how many query tags the adapter
forwards. PROVEN values only: booruorg = 'none' (booru-sources-core.cjs
accepts `variant` and never puts it in the URL; the WAF forces tagless
browsing), paheal = 'single' (main.cjs takes variant.split(/\s+/)[0]).
dapi/moebooru/realhtml DO forward the tags, but whether the remote
treats spaces as AND is their business, so it stays UNKNOWN here: the
authoritative gate is src/game/matchRule.ts, applied to every result.
maxTags: hard cap when known (paheal 1). Absent = unknown.
postFilter: true = the adapter CANNOT filter server-side and we filter
locally after fetching, which costs a full round per candidate. This is
the booru.org family's known cost, recorded rather than papered over.
pagination: 'random-pid' | 'page' | 'none' — audited from the builder.
rendition: which size the adapter returns. Unknown where unverified.

sources._disabledReason: rule34.booru.org answers 301 -> https://rule34.xxx/ (verified 2026-10-07, Cloudflare Location header): this 'booru.org sub' is now a redirect to rule34.xxx, the login-walled source removed from the registry on purpose. In the browser dev proxy the redirect escapes the proxy and dies on CORS; in Electron main it follows to a login page that parses to nothing. Either way it is a wasted request in every round. Kept as a disabled row (like utopia) so the measurement is not lost; re-enable if the subdomain ever serves its own list again.

Every sampled page (80 posts across pid 0/400/8000/16000) is rating:Questionable, never Explicit — confirmed in both the thumb title= and the posts[N] JS literal. Under the fail-closed 18+ gate this source yields ZERO posts forever. Kept documented rather than deleted so the probe result is not lost; re-check if its ratings ever change.

$byteHostsComment: Non-booru image hosts the dev /px byte proxy may fetch (allowlist - no open proxy).
Chat/feed avatars and CDN-hosted post media. Booru hosts come from the sources above.
